name: report
notes: Wire enum values are snake_case (wrong_phone_number); Dart ReportReason.name is camelCase (wrongPhoneNumber). The adapter must convert both ways.

Today anon may INSERT but not SELECT reports (0009 lines 193-194), so PostgREST 'Prefer: return=representation' fails with an RLS error. Use return=minimal and generate the id client-side, or add a submit_report RPC that returns {id, status, createdAt}. Dart submit() returns Future<Report>.

Today the client can also send status, reviewed_at, resolution_note and reporter_phone_e164 (no column restriction, no CHECK); the target contract accepts only provider_id, reason, details and optional contact.
